# Oybek Jalolov

> Oybek Jalolov is a mobile developer from Uzbekistan building native (Kotlin, Swift) and Flutter apps for Android and iOS. 2+ years, 20+ published apps, including UzAutoSavdo (1M+ downloads).

Oybek Jalolov (also written Jalolov Oybek; Russian: Ойбек Жалолов) is a mobile developer from Uzbekistan. He builds native Android (Kotlin, Java) and native iOS (Swift) apps as well as cross-platform Flutter apps, and has 2+ years of experience. He has published 20+ apps on Google Play and the App Store. He obtained a D-U-N-S number and registered his own organization developer accounts on Google Play and the App Store. He is the founder of Mudarris AI (https://mudarrisai.uz). He works remotely with clients in Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Afghanistan.

## Notable apps

- UzAutoSavdo (UzAuto Motors JSC) — 1M+ downloads: The official UzAuto Motors app: car catalog, dealers on the map, and online booking for service and test drives. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uzavtosanoat.uz, appstore: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/uzavtosavdo/id1438093426)
- Carsale Dealer (IT PROF COMMUNITY): The whole car dealership in one app: sales, CRM, stock, service and call center. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uz.itpc.carsale, appstore: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/carsale-dealer/id6761598674)
- Mudarris AI (Own product · founder): An AI tutor for Uzbekistan’s DTM and national certificate exams: mock tests in the real format, explanations of mistakes and score forecasts. Oybek founded and built it and published it under his own organization developer account. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uz.mudarristech.mudarrisai, appstore: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/mudarris-ai/id6787001407, web: https://mudarrisai.uz)
- Aqlli Hisobchi AI (AI finance assistant): An AI assistant for money, debts, tasks and habits: type an expense, say it or snap a receipt, and AI logs it for you. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uz.hisobchi.aqlli_hisobchi_ai, appstore: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/aqlli-hisobchi-ai/id6780379860)
- Medhome (Medhome): Book a nurse or carer to your home: injections, IV drips, massage and patient care. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uz.medhome.medhome.medhome, appstore: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/medhome/id6760206618, web: https://medhome.uz)
- Egalla (Startup): A fitness game: walk, run or cycle a loop around part of the city to claim that area, then compete on the leaderboard. (play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uz.egalla.egalla, appstore: coming soon)

## Services

- Mobile app development (Android and iOS): I build fast, polished and reliable apps for Android and iOS, native (Kotlin, Swift) or Flutter, whichever fits your project best.
- Getting a D-U-N-S number: I’ll get a D-U-N-S number for your company. Apple and Google require it to publish apps under an organization’s name.
- Organization developer accounts on Google Play and the App Store: I’ll register your organization on Google Play Console and Apple Developer and set everything up correctly.
- Publishing apps to Google Play and the App Store: I prepare the store listing, screenshots and privacy policy, take the app through Google and Apple review and get it live.

## Experience

- Jan 2026 – Present: Mobile Developer, IT PROF COMMUNITY. Building the mobile apps of the Carsale platform for car dealerships: a CRM for dealers and a marketplace for customers. Apps: Carsale Dealer, Carsale Marketplace
- Oct 2025 – Jan 2026: Mobile Developer, UzAuto Motors. Built the UzAvtosalon and UzAutoSavdo apps for UzAuto Motors, including a full rewrite of UzAutoSavdo in Flutter that shipped to both stores; the app has over 1 million downloads. Apps: UzAutoSavdo, UzAvtosalon
- Mar 2025 – Oct 2025: Mobile Developer, Metrology Scientific Center. Developed the center’s official mobile app and the GazTexnoPribor app. Apps: Metrology Scientific Center, GazTexnoPribor
- Jul 2024 – Apr 2025: Grant winner · mobile development, GITA Programmers Academy. Won a grant and started studying mobile development. During the course I built about 20 apps, including demo versions of well-known apps. Apps: 2048, Quiz App, Puzzle 15, Translation App, Uzum Market (demo), Texnomart (demo), MaxWay (demo), Zoomrad (demo)
